## Ravenous Human (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
Male ravenous human fighter 5  
CE Medium monstrous humanoid  
 **Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +6 natural)  
 **hp** 60 (5d10+10)  
 **Fort** +5; **Ref** +6; **Will** +4  
 **Immune** fear; **Resist** cold 5, electricity 5  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** 2 claws +11 (1d4+5), bite +10 (1d6+5)  
 **Special Attacks** primal scream (DC 14), rage  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 20, **Dex** 15, **Con** 14, **Int** 3, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 14  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 22  
 **Feats** Great Fortitude B, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Survival)B, [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw).*  
 **Skills** Perception +8, Stealth +7, Survival +4
